backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining all user data types and in-memory maps for tasks, notes, reminders, timers, profiles, rewards, and related state.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that currently performs a no-op state upgrade.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for many frontend React components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file loading the Scholar Gold React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication flow, background settings, and tab-based navigation across all app sections.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: UI component for purchasing, uploading, or generating backgrounds with coin checks, camera capture, and rarity-tier options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with branding and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the app header with theme toggle, authentication handling, and user avatar menu.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Provides a full-page marketing-style login screen with feature cards and Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Manages creation, editing, and deletion of notes with image and voice attachments.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: Shows and edits the user profile, including avatar upload, bio, streaks, and level progression.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for first‑time profile setup, capturing name and optional bio.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Schedules and displays browser notifications for upcoming reminders, persisting notified IDs.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: UI for listing, adding, editing, and deleting reminders with date/time validation and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Implements a persistent stopwatch that syncs with the backend, restores state on load, and handles start, pause, and reset actions.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Pomodoro/custom timer with persistence, notifications, session recording, and coin/streak integration.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Renders a checkbox to mark a timetable entry as completed today based on tick history. Toggles completion state via mutation with error handling.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog for editing a timetable entry’s title and activity type, with validation and update mutation. Displays schedule info in read-only form.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Shows a dialog listing the last six months of completion data for a timetable entry, including metrics and a scrollable daily history. Fetches tick history and visualizes completion status with icons.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: Displays and manages daily timetable entries with add, edit, delete, and completion-history dialogs.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Task list component supporting creation, editing, completion toggling, and deletion with backend integration.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyStudyTimeG: Displays a weekly stacked bar chart of study session minutes using fetched session data and shows total time metrics. Handles loading state, aggregates sessions, and renders category-specific totals.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity, including automatic recreation and query invalidation when identity changes. Loads admin token if provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration. Wraps AuthClient setup with custom options and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for interacting with backend methods such as profiles, coins, backgrounds, study sessions, and timetable entries. Handles fetch logic, mutations, and related cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/component/utility layers plus light and dark OKLCH CSS variable themes and global body/border styling.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Wrapper around toast and browser notifications with helpers for timers, reminders, and permission handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React root with React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to short user-friendly messages with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Provides helpers to format timestamps into date keys and check if a timestamp falls on today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates day ranges and maps tick history into daily completion flags for the last six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash routing.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyStudyGraph.ts: Aggregates completed study sessions into per-day totals for the last seven days by session type.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme with OKLCH color variables, custom radius, shadows, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project-wide state file describing planned features, constraints, issues, and architectural notes.
